children: Shares of Redwire rose after the company secured a follow-on order from the U.S. Army to provide maintenance parts for its combat fleet.
Shares increased 7% to $8.70 on Wednesday. The stock is up 14% year to date.
The Army's aviation unit situated in Fort Huachuca, Arizona will receive Redwire maintenance parts, including its hybrid lift batteries, for its stalker uncrewed aircraft system.
The follow-on order will support the Army's individual training on the aircraft, helping soldiers train on a tested aircraft they can rely on for real-world operations, Redwire said.
